config.brute_force_culling.title: Brute Force Culling Config
config.brute_force_culling.option.enable: Turns all culling done by this mod on or off.
config.brute_force_culling.option.cullEn: Skips rendering entities that are hidden behind terrain. Requires OpenGL 3.3.
config.brute_force_culling.option.cullBl: Skips rendering block entities, such as chests and signs, that are hidden behind terrain. Requires OpenGL 3.3.
config.brute_force_culling.option.cullCh: Skips rendering chunk sections that are completely hidden behind terrain.
config.brute_force_culling.option.sampli: Resolution of the depth texture used for culling, relative to the screen. Higher values cull more accurately at a small GPU cost. Avoid going below 20%.
config.brute_force_culling.option.update: Frames to wait before reading the culling results back from the GPU. Higher values avoid stalls but make culling react more slowly. With shaders enabled the delay is raised by one frame automatically.
config.brute_force_culling.option.tickCu: Also skips the client-side update of entities that are currently hidden, including everything outside your field of view. Saves processor time when many entities are loaded. Hidden entities stop spawning particles and their animations pause until they come back into view. Mob sounds come from the server and are unaffected. Entities within 16 blocks, glowing entities, ridden entities and anything on the skip lists keep updating. Requires Cull Entities.
config.brute_force_culling.option.vegeta: Hides half of the grass, flowers and other small plants in chunks far from the camera. Covers modded plants that are bushes, are tagged as flowers, or use a plant sound with no collision. Crops, stems, saplings, sugar cane, vines and nether wart are never hidden. Requires Sodium.
Distance where vegetation thinning starts, as a percentage of the render distance.
config.brute_force_culling.option.entity: Entity types that are never culled, for example minecraft:zombie.
config.brute_force_culling.option.blockE: Block entity types that are never culled, for example minecraft:chest.
config.brute_force_culling.option.modSki: Mod ids whose entities and block entities are never culled.
config.brute_force_culling.option.checkC: Inverts the culling result so the world draws only what culling removed. Anything you can still see is being culled wrongly. Applies to entities and block entities, and to chunks when Sodium is installed. While enabled the culling maps stop updating, so the result is a snapshot from the moment it was switched on: stand still while reading it and switch it off before moving on. Resets when the debug overlay is closed.
config.brute_force_culling.option.checkT: Draws the depth textures and culling maps on screen while the debug overlay is open.
